[[Runar's Brimstone Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Runar Brimstone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Air Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[Elemental damage]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Air Staff (lightning spire)]].
